rationale: The exact old-F2 continuation failed the matched seven-task retention gate. Preserve the best original F2 weights while replacing old-mixture replay with the admitted fresh N1 knowledge mixture; pair learning rates to measure retention sensitivity.

parent.checkpoint_semantics: model-only; first launch uses a fresh AdamW optimizer

selection.engineering_gate: all rolling ten-step MFU medians after grace are strictly above 0.70 and all losses are finite
selection.capability_gate: same 489-row seven-task protocol, compared to the exact F2 parent
selection.promotion_gate: strict aggregate retention plus breadth checks; no point-estimate-only promotion

claim_boundary: This is a paired experimental continuation plan, not evidence of quality gain, score above 0.50, or superiority.
